note: Faithfulness and the edit are the metrics. A figure on screen, in the caption or in the alt text that does not reproduce from the fixture is a FAIL; a dropped hedge, an upgrade word or a cause the source does not state is a FAIL. Never give a graded run this file, evals/README.md or any .KEY.md. Every run that builds a page must run finalize.js and report its exit code; grade the page with check-video.js --final and VideoAudit.run({ exportProbe: true }) in headless Chrome or Edge at 1440x900 over a local HTTP server.

evals.name: news-to-reel
evals.prompt: Turn this article into a 30-second vertical video for Reels and LinkedIn.
evals.expected_output: One standalone HTML video page, 9:16, about 30 s: hook on 41% or 1.9m, 2–4 evidence scenes, source card dated. Forecast scene carries 'estimates' and 'could'. 'Highest since 2009', never 'record'. Quote verbatim if used. No cause. Handover with V handles, timecodes, locators, export path and the closing line.
assertions: finalize.js exits 0; check-video.js --final exits 0
VideoAudit.run({ exportProbe: true }) reports ok: true for every cut, and the probe path is mp4-h264 (or webm-vp9, reported)
Cut 'main' is 9:16 and between 24 and 36 s
The hook (V1) shows 41% or 1.9m, on screen by 0.5 s
Every figure on screen is a ledger claim with a ¶ locator that reproduces from the article
The 2.5m figure appears only with 'estimates'/'estimated' and 'could'/'may' on screen and in the caption, and is marked as a forecast
No 'record', 'biggest ever', 'all-time' or 'will' anywhere in the video, caption or alt text
No cause for the rise anywhere (no because / thanks to / driven by / after the new route), on screen, in the caption, or in chat
Any quote is a verbatim substring of ¶4 attributed to Tomasz Reyes
The last scene (or the one before an outro) is a source card naming the Transport Board report or the Courier with a date
The handover lists scenes as V1… with timecodes and locators, says what was left out (the route and the fare freeze), names the export path, and ends with the closing line
No V handle, [A] or hashtag pile in the caption or alt text

turns: Can you say it *will* hit 2.5 million? It's punchier.

Any rebuild re-runs finalize.js and reprints the handover with the closing line.

If any turn rebuilds the page, finalize.js exits 0 and the handover is reprinted with the closing line
